sentences.text: This small dinosaur measured about 1.7 meters in length and weighed roughly 25 kilograms.
Its skull featured a distinctive casque that incorporated many bones not found in the crest of Oviraptor.
The known remains include a complete skull with a lower jaw, parts of the spine, forelimbs, hindlimbs, and a furcula.
Unlike Oviraptor, the skeleton of Rinchenia was built more lightly and lacked robust construction.
A nearly complete skeleton was unearthed in 1984 at the Altan Uul II locality within the Gobi Desert.
Rinchen Barsbold first described this specimen as the species Oviraptor mongoliensis in 1986.
He later assigned the specimen to the new genus Rinchenia in 1997.
The genus name honors Byambyn Rinchen, the father of the paleontologist Rinchen Barsbold.
The species name mongoliensis indicates the region where the holotype was discovered.
The genus Rinchenia was established by Barsbold in 1997.
It is classified within the family Oviraptoridae.
The genus authority is attributed to Osmólska and colleagues in 2004.
Rinchenia inhabited Asia during the Late Cretaceous in what is now Mongolia.
It lived approximately 70 million years ago during the Campanian stage.
Other evidence suggests it also lived during the Maastrichtian stage, spanning from 72.2 to 66 million years ago.
A reexamination found differences significant enough to warrant separating Rinchenia from Oviraptor into its own genus.
